newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Elec & Eltek sees rosy future.
newsitem.headline: Elec & Eltek sees rosy future.

text.p: Printed circuit board (PCB) maker Elec & Eltek International Co Ltd said on Thursday it was optimistic about the future outlook of the PCB industry.

The company, which has substantial activities in Hong Kong and China, said in a statement with its first-half results it expected particularly strong business growth in Europe and would focus on expanding its market share both there and in the United States.

"To ensure we are well positioned to exploit business opportunities as the electronics sector turns around, the group has committed to an interim expansion plan to increase the capacity of our Huangpu plant and Kaiping plant," it said.
"Barring unforeseen circumstances, the directors expect the results of the second half of the current financial year to be satisfactory," it added.
Elec & Eltek reported an 8.3 percent rise year-on-year in its first-half results to Singapore $25.26 million.
